La PET-TC con FDG è l'esame di riferimen:
FDG PET-CT is the reference exam for the staging of lung carcinoma: it defines T, N (hypermetabolic hilar and mediastinal lymph nodes) and M (liver, adrenals, bones; the brain is studied with MRI because the cortex takes up a lot of FDG).
Physiologic uptake to recognize: brain, myocardium (variable), kidneys, ureters and bladder (urinary elimination), bowel, tonsils, muscles after exertion, brown fat.
Small cell carcinoma is typically central, very FDG-avid, with large lymphadenopathy and early metastases (liver, adrenals, brain, bones): at diagnosis it is often already extensive, and is treated with chemo-immunotherapy rather than surgery.
In the report: SUVmax and diameter of the main lesion, lymph node stations involved, sites of metastasis, and the TNM stage.
In stadiazione PET: prima riconosci gli: In PET staging: first recognize the physiologic uptake, then T, N and M.
